name: LCSC & DigiKey Component Importer and Smart BOM
description: Import symbols, footprints, and 3D models from LCSC/EasyEDA and DigiKey, and export priced BOMs.
description_full:
Search and import electronic components from LCSC (EasyEDA) and DigiKey directly into KiCad libraries (.kicad_sym, .kicad_mod, .step, .wrl) with automatic sym-lib-table and fp-lib-table registration.

Features:
- Live 2D Schematic Symbol and PCB Footprint preview before import
- Automatic category-based or unified library organization (Global or Project scope)
- Embeds full supplier and engineering metadata (MPN, Manufacturer, LCSC Part #, DigiKey Part #, Unit Price, Stock, Datasheet) into symbols
- Smart BOM & Live Pricing/Stock manager supporting Engineering CSV, JLCPCB PCBA BOM, and DigiKey Bulk Upload CSV
- Accessible from both Schematic Editor (Eeschema) and PCB Editor (Pcbnew) in KiCad 9/10.
- Note: User interface is currently provided in Turkish.
